newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids remain up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids remain up.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids continued their uptrend on Wednesday boosted by some domestic mill demand, dealers said.
But movement remains fairly slow as producers wait for higher prices, dealers said.
There was more demand from domestic mills. Domestic mills are looking for offers for October through December delivery, a Minneapolis dealer said.
A forecast of rain and snow for Wednesday night and Thursday in parts of the Northern Plains, particularly Montana, may slow some winter wheat seedings, dealers said.
"This is welcomed moisture. It may hold up a few people," a Montana broker said.
Pacific Northwest dealers noted sluggish movement. "People are waiting for higher prices," an Oregon dealer said. "They got a taste of it this spring and they still want it."
